latin: Quod scribit Tabet Chaldeus de dormitione super epar in reuelatione somniorum recte intelligetur si ad hoc dictum dicta Platonis in Timeo concordauerimus.
translation: What Thabit the Chaldean writes about sleeping upon the liver, in connection with the revelation of dreams, will be correctly understood if we bring this saying into agreement with what Plato says in the Timaeus.
